browser.limits: Observed paths only; no simulation of all browser or network failures

boundaries: Full Mandarin and English language exports plus direct pair file, not all Tatoeba languages and not the old 10000-pair sample.
SHA256 is locally computed content identity, not a publisher checksum.
Matching before/after metadata is checked; upstream does not provide an atomic three-file snapshot guarantee.
Source owner is retained and not claimed to be original author; missing owner and endpoint quality counts remain visible.
SourceError is retryable only for SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED; unknown execution errors, lease expiry and delivery failure permit finite manual retry, maximum three attempts.
Private VALIDATED acquisition does not create catalog release, mount or query-ready index. Production tools, release permission and model egress remain unapproved.
No formal capacity acceptance, no scheduled multi-source governance, no automatic orphan-object cleanup.
Initial official two-run attempt succeeded first run but failed second early; later result does not erase that failure and no speculative root cause is asserted.
